name: Amanda Hu
evidence: Correct person located but no address exists in reachable sources. Anchored on the paper: the LLM-GLOBE author list (Elise Karinshak, Amanda Hu, Kewen Kong, Vishwanatha Rao, Jingren Wang, Jindong Wang, Yi Zeng) was confirmed verbatim from the benchmark repo README at raw.githubusercontent.com/raovish6/LLM-GLOBE (free fetch), and the affiliation anchor is Schwarzman College, Tsinghua University, where she was a 2024 Schwarzman Scholar (senior in biology and business management, founding member of Encreto Therapeutics - used to separate her from the many namesakes). Two queries (shared-paper query for all three LLM-GLOBE rows; her name + Kong + Schwarzman/Tsinghua + email) returned no address. The arXiv author block, ar5iv mirror and lacuna mirror are all egress-blocked; the README carries no contact address. Name is too common to accept anything weaker.
